name: Signature Shiny

components.expression: a cool, calculating stare, utterly composed.
components.effects: Fine ice crystals drift and glitter in the air around her, faint {{MAGIC}} frost-light tracing her silhouette. A fine prismatic glitter and a gilded, holographic shimmer play across the metal, the fabric and the magic, every glow edged with a rainbow sheen.
components.companion: her aligned Elder Dragon, Glaciora, visible beyond the hall's high windows, an Elder Dragon of glacial-cyan and frost-white scales, wreathed in drifting ice crystals, wings like panes of frosted crystal edged in brushed chrome

notes: SHINY variant of the Signature: same scene and pose in a prismatic, gilded colourway with a holographic glitter sheen. Convention: <slug>-scene-signature-shiny.
